links.outcome: EVLP specialist decisions with versus without model support in retrospective blinded implementation study
links.effect: InsighTx increased likelihood of transplanting suitable donor lungs (OR=13; 95% CI 4-45) and decreased likelihood of transplanting unsuitable lungs (OR=0.4; 95% CI 0.16-0.98).
links.quote: In a retrospective and blinded implementation study by EVLP specialists at our institution, InsighTx increased the likelihood of transplanting suitable donor lungs [odds ratio=13; 95% CI:4-45] and decreased the likelihood of transplanting unsuitable donor lungs [odds ratio=0.4; 95%CI:0.16-0.98].

screen.reason: The study evaluates a machine learning model (InsighTx) for predicting lung transplant outcomes, including a reader study measuring specialist decision changes with vs. without AI assistance.
